name: MailTub Self-Hosted Disposable Email
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted disposable-email server with WebSocket inbox updates and no subscription expiry; default maximum 5 concurrent inboxes per session, 20 mailbox creations per IP per hour, and selectable mailbox lifetimes of 1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours or 7 days.
watch_out: You supply a server, domain, MX/DNS, storage and SMTP port access; hosting is not free. API access is open unless API_KEY is set, and STARTTLS is disabled by default. One-commit upstream repository with limited operational track record; evaluate security and reliability before production use. Mailbox expiry is not a trial expiry.
